title: Revolute

inlines.v: REV'OLUTE, adjective [Latin revolutus, from revolvo.] In botany, rolled back or downwards; as revolute foliation or leafing, when the sides of the leaves in the bud are rolled spirally back or towards the lower surface; a revolute leaf or tendril; a revolute corol or valve.
